finding.mechanism: urb->actual_length (controller-set at bulk-in completion) used as buffer_size with no >=3 check -> memcpy(buffer+3, p_buffer, buffer_size-3) underflows u32 to ~4GB into kmalloc(actual_length) on 0/1/2-byte (ZLP/short) completions; buffer_filled then memcpy(vbuf, data, len) with len = full actual_length into vb2 plane sized mpeglinesize*mpeglines = 65536 (queue_setup:1232) with no bound; URB buffers are 320*max_pkt_size (cx231xx-core.c:1191,1205); isoc sibling cx231xx_isoc_copy:1315 checks buffer_size>0 and routes via guarded buffer_copy (asymmetric validation)

notes: usbip and gb-beagleplay hdr.size are parse-time wire counts, excluded by rule; iforce-usb.c:162 and cx231xx-vbi/video bulk copies left as coverage gaps
